Disaster Management System — a project connecting citizens, responders, and administrators through web and mobile experiences.

Explore the repository ↗Discuss a similar idea ↗
PROJECT TYPEGraduation project
INTERFACESFlutter & React
BACKENDSpring Boot REST API

The idea

A shared picture when information matters.

The project explores how incident reporting, emergency resources, and coordination can come together in one system. Different interfaces support citizens, responders, and administrators.

It is an academic project, with source code and setup instructions available on GitHub.

Inside the project

Connected features, clear roles.

◎

Reporting & awareness

Incident reports, maps, emergency SOS, weather, news, and safety guidance.

↔

Coordination

Shelter information, notifications, and resource and team management.

◐

Adaptable interfaces

Multiple languages and light/dark themes across the application.

The technical side

Web and mobile, connected by an API.

The Flutter application uses Riverpod, GoRouter, Dio, and Hive. The repository also includes a React web frontend and the shared Spring Boot backend.
